On Tue, Apr 26, 2022 at 5:46 PM Clare Amador ‹ [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Gerrv!
Thanks for reaching out. The real story is that Vic Rodriguez's account was flagged for impersonation (nothing about content). We
have restored the account since then (in the morning of April 26th). We have also released our statement to press.
You may have heard about the issue around Facebook blocking articles and posts from the Philippine News Agency and Radyo
Pilipinas, which was being attributed to the fact checkers. We have also released a statement around this (the websites have a
shoddy code/script that was flagged by our system and was blocked as a preventive measure; we also found other govt and non-
govt sites that have it). We also published an explainer on our third party factchecker program.
Feel free to check in if you have any more questions around these issues. I have shared with our gov't stakeholders that, in large
part, the issues that recently come up are part of the imperfections of technology (and not really about our politics).
Stay safe,
Clare
